name: Toast
intent: Show a brief, non-blocking status - success, error, warning, info, default, or a loading spinner - with an optional description and actions.

figmaSource.notes: Figma has appearance (default/success/error/warning/info/loading) x open (false/true). `open` maps to the code `expanded` prop (collapsed = title only, expanded = description + actions). The leading visual is an IconTile (Figma appearance=blue/green/... maps to IconTile tone); loading shows a Spinner. Toasts are shown/stacked by ToastGroup.

useCases: show a pending operation with a spinner and resolve it later
warn or report an error non-blockingly
antiPatterns: the only copy of a critical message

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: raised-surface card with a 1px border, radius-xl, and the overlay elevation shadow

anatomy.name: leadingIcon
anatomy.description: an IconTile colored per appearance, or a Spinner for loading; decorative

anatomy.name: dismiss
anatomy.description: a dismiss IconButton (xs, subtle) in the title row

expanded.description: Whether the description and actions are shown.

behaviorRules: Render the leading IconTile colored per appearance, or a Spinner for the loading appearance.
Always render the title; render the description and actions only when expanded and provided.
Show the dismiss button unless isDismissible is false; call onDismiss when it is clicked.
Render on a raised surface with the overlay elevation shadow.
Default role to status (a polite live region).
compositionRules: Prefer showing toasts through ToastGroup and the toast() API rather than rendering Toast directly.
Pass Buttons (typically size xs, subtle) to actions.
Use the loading appearance for a pending operation and update the same id when it resolves.
contentRules: Keep the title short; put detail in the description.
Do not put the only copy of a critical message in a toast.
Do not rely on color alone to convey the appearance.
themeRules: Use theme CSS variables for all color values.
Do not use primitive color tokens directly.
Dark theme is supported through the generated token variables.
implementationNotes: Compose IconTile, Spinner, IconButton, and the StatusIcon set.
do: Use Toast for brief, transient, non-blocking status.
Use the appropriate appearance for the meaning.
Keep it dismissible unless it resolves on its own.
dont: Do not use Toast for persistent or blocking messages.
Do not hide the only path to an action inside a toast.
Do not hardcode colors, spacing, or typography.
acceptanceCriteria: Renders an IconTile for non-loading appearances and a Spinner for loading.
Shows the description and actions only when expanded.
Shows a dismiss button by default and calls onDismiss; omits it when isDismissible is false.
Renders on a raised surface with a radius-xl corner, a 1px border, and the overlay shadow.
Forwards the ref to the root element.
